name: RuBench
description: Developers increasingly delegate real maintenance work to product-grade coding agents, and many state tasks in their native language, in the style of a customer request rather than a curated English issue. We introduce RuBench 1.0, a benchmark of 25 tasks mined from recent fix commits in five live open-source repositories (aiohttp, aiogram, Laravel, NestJS, Fastify), each specified natively in Russian -- written from scratch, not translated -- and judged by the upstream maintainer's regression tests, which we withhold from release.
